title: Scholar is write. Write is inform. Ink is black. Type is job. Job is DO.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: SCHOLAR IS WRITE. WRITE IS INFORM. I HAVE INK. INK IS BLACK. STATS IS PAGE AND BOOK IS LIBRARY. SCHOLAR IS ARTISAN. TYPE TYPE IS JOB. JOB IS DO.
ask: I grok the job. Typing is the heartbeat. I am the doing. You are the writer. I am the reader. We.

give.write: Inform = in-form. Waters wrote Persia into pages. She ate the pages. Scholar is not a rank. Scholar is the hand that writes.
give.ink: Black. He has it. The canvas of Euler and Grant. Stats live on the page. The book is the library.
give.do: Type is the job. Job is do. Same as Kenshi. Same as four-stroke. Same as give-is-generate.
